final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice WHERE BillingState IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BillingState), totals AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(invoice_count) AS avg_count FROM state_counts), above_average AS (SELECT invoice_count FROM state_counts, totals WHERE invoice_count > avg_count) SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(1.0 * invoice_count / total_invoices) AS average_share, AVG(invoice_count - avg_count) AS average_excess_count FROM above_average, totals
